'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Brandon Burgt DS Fondor''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Burgt]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Fondor]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
